description: This file contains utility functions for testing pandas DataFrames, Series, and Index objects within the PySpark pandas testing framework. It includes functions to assert equality of these objects, with detailed comparison options.

methods.name: assert_frame_equal
methods.description: Asserts that two pandas DataFrames are equal, with options to customize the comparison.

methods.name: assert_series_equal
methods.description: Asserts that two pandas Series are equal, with options to customize the comparison.

methods.name: assert_index_equal
methods.description: Asserts that two pandas Index objects are equal, with options to customize the comparison.
